notes.title: Full Patch of Bugs + New Multiplayer mode
notes.content:
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
The reason for not updating this game as of recent is due to me being busy with other things but fear not! I am back now and the following update to this will be massive. I have already implemented basic multiplayer tasks into this live build and there's just a few more things to do before I can release it to everyone. I am very happy to say that this game will now be getting the love and attention it deserves.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
- Fixed Lagging issues on lower end systems
- Fixed random freezing when picking up an object
- Fixed the AI
- Story Mode has now developed and is easier to accomplish
- The random map generation system is now being fixed and I have finally fixed the buggy map generation


I would like to thank you all for showing support and love towards this game. It has been a rough couple of years, but I would like to say that this has been a massive step up for me.

- The random map generation system is now being fixed and I have finally fixed the buggy map generation

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE v1.02
notes.content:
Today we're finally happy to release the 1st major update since release! This update offers brand new features, and new exciting story lines that have been added.

A few of the bugs that were previously not fixed in the last update should now of been fixed. I would like to also mention that I'm sorry about us going silent, and sorry that we haven't released any updates as of recent.

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Amount of moves have been fixed
[*] Elevator levels have been fixed
[*] Pickup-able key issues fixed
[*] Coin saving systems fixed
[/list]

[h1]Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new level design - New texture
[*] Redesigned some levels
[*] Enemy AI reworked
[*] Enemy AI added more purpose
[*] New Enemy UI
[*] Notes that popup to let you know
[*] New tutorials
[*] Added more Random Map Generation Camera variations
[*] RMG long door tiles
[*] Added key to UI with levels that have keys
[*] RMG added more tiles
[*] New and improved story line has been added
[*] New cinematic 
[/list]

We're working very hard to get updates out as quickly and as smoothly as possible and we appreciate all of the support everyone is giving us.

[u][b]WE STRONGLY RECOMMEND YOU RESTART YOUR SAVE FILE. TO DO THIS, GO TO THE MAIN MENU ON THE GAME AND GO TO OPTIONS, AND SET "CLEAR SAVE" TO YES THEN CLICK APPLY. THIS WAY YOU WILL GET ALL THE NEW STORY[/b][/u]

Enjoy this update!

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE v1.01.2
notes.content:
Today's minor update is bringing a number of fixes and updates related to the early access of NobleEscape.

A few things have been fixed since the last update and the development team have been working hard to solve these issues that people are having.

Bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Coins not working
[*] Save system has been fixed
[*] Small texture issues have been fixed
[*] Elevators have been removed, temporarily due to issues with them 
[/list]

I would also like to address some of the concern in the community about NobleEscape. We are still working hard on the game and are currently working on the, hopefully big v1.02 release. This will be the big v2 of the Early Access stage and this will mainly focus on our RMG (Random Map Generation) and story of the game. We understand that the current game doesn't offer much story, but we're adding more to it.

Thanks everyone so far for supporting us!

tags.bug: Small texture issues have been fixed
Elevators have been removed, temporarily due to issues with them

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE v1.01.1
notes.content:
Today minor update bringing a number of fixes related to the early access release of NobleEscape.

This includes:
[list]
[*] End of level issues fixed
[*] Scaling issues with UI fixed
[*] Main Menu lighting fixed
[*] Random map generation Key spawn fixed
[*] Random map generation Elevator teleport issues fixed
[*] Added clear save option in main menu
[/list]

We are aware of further issues and they are being investigated and fixed. We are also working on reworking the Random Map Generation to add more variety to the levels. 

Happy new year!
